approval: Values confirmed by the user on 2026-11-16 (P9d PRD section 2 items 6-7 and section 6); frozen at P9d PR0 before any E2E run. Penetration follows physical_gates_v2 (5% of the smallest object dimension, 40 mm); self-penetration is 5% of the smallest Allegro link dimension (16.4 mm). Measured offline in FP64 by floating_hand_criteria on every published frame.
acceptance: FP32 CUDA production graph; FP64 runs are diagnostic and reported separately

E3.negative_control: the same recipe with --self-collision off must exceed self_penetration_max_m

performance.metric: median solver.step time per step on floating_hand_fixed_grasp_box_v1.json, floating root versus 6-joint wrist (user 2026-11-16, P9d plan K17); 0- and 1-Newton step medians and Newton/PCG counts reported separately
performance.self_collision_on: set by the user after the PR4 measurement (K5)
